description: Adds Gamertag Search button to roster index page actions
find:
<xf:pageaction if="$xf.visitor.canManageRosterUsers()">
    <xf:button href="{{ link('rosters/add-user', $selectedRoster) }}" class="button--cta" icon="add">
        {{ phrase('add_user') }}
    </xf:button>
</xf:pageaction>
replace:
<xf:pageaction>
    <xf:button href="{{ link('rosters/search-overlay') }}" icon="search" overlay="true">Gamertag Search</xf:button>
    <xf:if is="$xf.visitor.canManageRosterUsers()">
        <xf:button href="{{ link('rosters/add-user', $selectedRoster) }}" class="button--cta" icon="add">
            {{ phrase('add_user') }}
        </xf:button>
    </xf:if>
</xf:pageaction>
